title: Citus: etcd quorum + per-group HA + Citus workers + sharding proof
description: Runs `nexus health citus`: etcd quorum (union across nodes — defeats the 127.0.1.1 self-probe artifact), per-group single-leader + replication lag, the operator mTLS round-trip via the coordinator VIP, the registered-worker count from pg_dist_node, the sharding proof (events shards span both worker groups), and a distributed cross-shard aggregate.

observe.what: all green: etcd-quorum 3/3, each group 1 leader + streaming replica (0 MB lag), operator scram+mTLS via VIP, citus-workers 2, sharding worker1=16 worker2=16, distributed-query 800 rows
JSON HealthReport overallHealth=green; probes cover etcd, all 3 groups, operator-auth, citus-workers, sharding, distributed-query

whatProves: CitusAdapter.HealthAsync proves every layer: the etcd DCS quorum (unioned across nodes), Patroni HA per group, the Vault-KV operator credential over mTLS via the coordinator VIP, and the Citus distributed layer (registered workers + 16/16 shard spread + a distributed count).
